title: Medical Colleges (Telangana & Andhra Pradesh)
description: Government and private MBBS-granting medical colleges located in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
scope_note: Covers degree-granting medical colleges only. mbbs_seats is PENDING_VERIFICATION for most rows since current-year intake figures were not independently confirmable this session. ~17-19 newer (2022-2023) government colleges were excluded rather than guessed — see acquisition_backlog.json.

provenance.collection_method: WebSearch-based knowledge engineering research. Direct WebFetch to .gov.in/.ac.in/Wikipedia domains was blocked by this session's organizational egress policy (confirmed HTTP 403 policy denial, re-tested live before collection began) — same constraint documented in Package001_Geography and Package002_Education. Every fact is a cited search result; none fabricated.
provenance.confidence_calibration_note: Capped at 88 max (no row claims a 90+ 'direct official fetch' score) since no primary source page could be directly fetched and re-read for confirmation this session.

license: Compiled from public government, institutional, and reputable healthcare-journalism sources for ValueWeave internal knowledge-graph use; per-row source attribution preserved in source_url.
